semiconductor_relevance: High — Synergy-PE Sdn Bhd specializes in precision contract manufacturing for critical vacuum and semiconductor components, making them relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Synergy-PE Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian precision contract manufacturer focused on Copy Exact Manufacturing for vacuum and semiconductor components. They provide CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, and wet painting services, ensuring high precision and compliance with cleanroom standards.
capabilities: Sheet metal fabrication for semiconductor applications
Wet painting services for critical components

regional_presence.Malaysia: Synergy-PE operates facilities in Bayan Lepas, Batu Kawan, and Sungai Petani, focusing on high-mix, high-spec industries.
